system.description:
ATTACK INVOCATION WATER

You call forth a powerful blast of pressurized water that bludgeons the target and knocks it back. If the spell attack hits it inflicts 4d4 bludgeoning damage.

If the spell inflicts a critical injury with a severity of serious or greater, the target is also pushed back 5 feet.

Partly automated: the spell attack and its 4d4 bludgeoning. The 5-foot push on a serious or deadly critical injury is named on the card and moved by hand. (Inner Tempest, Chapter 8; brought into Block 5 by Graham's ruling B5-1 for Elemental Power.)
